faqs.question: Which courses are available at The Oxford College of Science for students?
faqs.answer: The Oxford College of Science offers courses at UG and PG levels in Science, Computer Applications and other streams. The college offers BSc and BCA at UG level and MCA, MSc and MA at the PG level. The college offers direct and online admission. Candidates can visit the campus or complete the process online.

faqs.question: How can I get into The Oxford College of Science for UG/PG courses? Am I eligible for admission?
faqs.answer:
The Oxford College of Science has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses:
Courses Eligibility
B.Sc. Candidate must have passed 10+2 with 35% including language Subjects.
PG Diploma Candidate must have passed MBBS, BDS, Bachelor of Pharmacy, B.E./ B.Tech in Biotechnology/ Bioinformatics/ Agriculture/ Veterinary, M.Sc. in Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ Bioinformatics with minimum 50% marks.
M.Sc. Candidate should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in the area of Apparel/ Textile/ Fashion Design.
MCA Candidate must have passed any recognised BCA / Bachelor degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent degree and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks (45% of marks in case of SC, ST and Category-I of Karnataka candidates) taken together in all the subjects in all the years of the Degree Examination from any recognised institute/university. OR Candidate must have passed B.Sc. / B.Com / B.A. with Mathematics at 10 + 2 level or at Graduation level (with additional bridge courses as per the norms of the concerned University) and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks (45% of marks in case of SC, ST and Category-I of Karnataka candidates) taken together in all the subjects in all the years of the Degree Examination from any recognised institute/university. Final year students can also apply on provisional basis.
M.A. Candidate must have passed with 40% marks in the aggregate of all subjects and mentioned marks in B.A./B.Sc./B.Com./BBA/BCA. Graduates who have secured at least 55% marks in the Language concerned in the degree course are also eligible.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Electronics, Mathematics, Computer Science) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It provides good environment.

review_content.Placements: Placements are pretty much average. But the changes are going on. So it can still be considered I would say. Last year (2023-24), 30 students got placed in companies. And hoping to see more students to be placements in this year (2024-25). Worth a shot I would recommend.
review_content.Infrastructure: The internet connection (Wi-Fi) is available on the campus. Labs and classrooms are maintained well. Library has a variety of books to offer. I would say book lovers and non-book lovers are both going to love it. The labs, classrooms, and library are spacious and well-equipped.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Biochemistry, Zoology, Microbiology) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: I recommend this college.

review_content.Placements: For B.Sc., there are no placements. If you have done an M.Sc. from the same college, you get placements in companies like Good Micro, Apollo, and various agri-tech firms. In Biochemistry, placements are in some of the best firms. The average placement package is 5 LAP and the minimum is 4 LPA. The maximum can go up to 8-9 LPA based on the skills you have gained.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has the best faculty. Most of them provide skilled teaching. College has the best library and free Wi-Fi. The auditorium has more than 250 seats. College gives more importance to extracurricular activities. You can also join NCC and NSS provided by the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: A home of talent where knowledge and innovative ideas meet.

review_content.Placements: According to my knowledge, at least 80% of students in our department were placed last year. The highest salary package offered by Deloitte is 12 LPA for the position of associate analyst. The lowest salary package offered is 3.70 LPA. Currently, students get internships on their own, but the faculty provides significant support and encouragement for securing internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus facilities are pretty good. There is a canteen around every corner of the campus. They have a huge library with easy access to books. It has different blocks for different departments. There is a sports room, a hostel, a gym, and stationery. The campus has everything students need in their daily life. Although things might be a bit expensive, it's worth it. I don't stay in the hostel, but the hostel facility is available. Pickup and drop from the hostel to the college is available because the place of the hostel is a little bit far from the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: If joining this college, better read this.

review_content.Placements: Out of 240 students, only 10-15 students got placed. Very bad placement ratio. Never read their brochure and believe it. Only one teaching company came, and all other companies were sales-based companies with low LPA. The LPA from the teaching company was only 3.6 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Coming to infrastructure, SEE, can you believe it? All Science, Commerce, Management, Arts, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Law are in only one building. Yes, including the cafeteria, all in one building, and no proper teaching at all.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: The Student of The College of Science

review_content.Placements: About 60% of students get placed in our college. By far, the highest package offered for our course is 6,00,000 per annum. Top recruiters include Infosys, Wipro, Infortech, and Intellipath. Roles offered include Data Analyst, Software Analyst, Data Scientist, Programmer, and Software Testing using programming languages.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are clean and very well maintained by the faculty. The classes are remodeled regularly for efficient concentration, providing students with air conditioning, and the infrastructure is environmentally friendly.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: Experienced and highly qualified teachers.

review_content.Placements: In our college, every year 40-50% students get placements. Placements in the college are not very high. The average package is around 3-4 LPA. Mostly regional companies visit for the placements. Most of the students get internships through the college with a good stipend.
review_content.Infrastructure: College has a very well maintained good infrastructure. There are facilities like big labs, libraries, canteen etc. The college has Wi-Fi facility but only teachers have access to it. The labs of the college are fully equipped. The canteen has only fast food. Library in the college is also fully stocked with books. College has no hostel facility. There are various sports facilities available in the college.

admission_process.title: The Oxford College of Science Admission Process

paragraphs: The Oxford College of Science admission 2024is currently open. The college offers courses, such as BSc, BCA, and MSc at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the college also offers PG diploma courses. To be admitted to The Oxford College of Science, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. The college offers more than 15 courses (including specialisations) in various streams such as Computer Application, Science, English etc. The application process at TOCS is conducted online. Read the following article to know more aboutThe Oxford College of Sciencecourse admission2024.

The mode of study at TOCS is full-time. The Oxford College of Science is affiliated withBangalore University. The college offers direct admission, Management quota, Government quota and University quota. The basic eligibility criteria to enrol for course admission at TOCS are Class 12 for UG courses and graduation for PG courses. Some of the popular courses are BSc, BCA, MSc etc. Read on to know more aboutThe Oxford College of Sciencecourse admissions2024.

The Oxford College of Science courses' admissions is a mix of direct and entrance exam scores. Candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularTOCS courses:
Read more:TOCS Brochure

The Oxford College of Science admission process consists of multiple rounds. Candidates need to meet the basic eligibility requirements to participate in the selection process. The detailed step-by-step admission process for The Oxford College of Science is as follows:
Step 1: Application Process
To apply for admission at TOCS, candidates must download the application form from the official website of the college.  Next, The downloaded form must be sent by email to the Institute of TOCS
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admissions at The Oxford College of Science is based on merit and for the MCA course admission candidates must have KCET entrance exam score. Aspirants are shortlisted based on their past academic qualifications and scores obtained in the respective entrance exams.
Step 3: Final Admission
After the completion of all the selection rounds, the selected candidates must pay a certain amount of fee to lock their seats.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good environment.
reviews.review_text: The internet connection (Wi-Fi) is available on the campus. Labs and classrooms are maintained well. Library has a variety of books to offer. I would say book lovers and non-book lovers are both going to love it. The labs, classrooms, and library are spacious and well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: I recommend this college.
reviews.review_text: The college has the best faculty. Most of them provide skilled teaching. College has the best library and free Wi-Fi. The auditorium has more than 250 seats. College gives more importance to extracurricular activities. You can also join NCC and NSS provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: A home of talent where knowledge and innovative ideas meet.
reviews.review_text: The campus facilities are pretty good. There is a canteen around every corner of the campus. They have a huge library with easy access to books. It has different blocks for different departments. There is a sports room, a hostel, a gym, and stationery. The campus has everything students need in their daily life. Although things might be a bit expensive, it's worth it. I don't stay in the hostel, but the hostel facility is available. Pickup and drop from the hostel to the college is available bec...

reviews.review_heading: If joining this college, better read this.
reviews.review_text: Coming to infrastructure, SEE, can you believe it? All Science, Commerce, Management, Arts, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Law are in only one building. Yes, including the cafeteria, all in one building, and no proper teaching at all.

reviews.review_heading: The Student of The College of Science
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are clean and very well maintained by the faculty. The classes are remodeled regularly for efficient concentration, providing students with air conditioning, and the infrastructure is environmentally friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Experienced and highly qualified teachers.
reviews.review_text: College has a very well maintained good infrastructure. There are facilities like big labs, libraries, canteen etc. The college has Wi-Fi facility but only teachers have access to it. The labs of the college are fully equipped. The canteen has only fast food. Library in the college is also fully stocked with books. College has no hostel facility. There are various sports facilities available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I do not recommend to join this college.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi available in the college. There is a library that is decent and good, with plenty of books available there. There is a canteen available with decent food taste and average quantity. There is no playground available; the general HSR playground is used.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied with the environment of our college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is not good. Labs provided for all the departments are not accomplished with needed accessories. Hostel facility is not available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of The Oxford College of Science.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Classrooms are not good. During free hours, students need to sit on staircases. There is no college ground so sports are very less. Labs are good and spacious. Library has many books that can be used for studies.

reviews.review_heading: TOCS review for BCA course .
reviews.review_text: Our college has a huge library with more than 10000 books. We have well maintained classroom. There is lab for each subject. Hostel facility is also available which provides good quality of foods. We have a canteen also in our campus. We have sports room too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of The Oxford College of Science.
reviews.review_text: We have a canteen on the last floor. It serves good food.

reviews.review_heading: This is a very good college for students.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi only for teachers, not for students. Classrooms are well maintained for students. There is a large library with thousands of books for us to study in order to get good marks. I am a day scholar. I have heard a lot of good things about the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a good college to study for your degree. But management is the worst.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides multiple facilities like Wi-Fi, a library, vast classrooms, labs for each subject, a canteen etc. The food in the canteen is really good. Other than these we have hostel facilities too. The hostel is well maintained and provides good quality food. Our college has a sports room too.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with faculty members but placements were good in 2021.
reviews.review_text: Our college encourages sports and fitness. We have a football ground, a basketball court, a volleyball court, a cricket ground, and table tennis facilities available. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. There is a hygienic cafeteria.

reviews.review_heading: The Oxford College of Science is an excellent institution for biochemistry.
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped labs, canteen and library. THE library has every book that is required. Previous year question papers are also available in the library. We can issue upto two books at a time. A department library is also available. The canteen is clean, hygienic and affordable.

reviews.review_heading: A college for efficient studies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not really pleasing. When you look at the ambience and sanitation, you would not be satisfied enough with it. I personally feel when it comes to infrastructure, it is the poorest of all. The canteen area is also not really soothing, so it's not up to mark.

reviews.review_heading: BBK DAV College for Girls, Amritsar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and buildings of BBK DAV College are very nice and well-maintained. The infrastructure is very beautiful, with gardens, parks, playgrounds, and many other clubs available. The facilities provided by the hostels are also first-class.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college does not provide good infrastructure and facilities. The library is not good. Classrooms are not good in condition. The hostel facility is below average. The food served in the hostel is not good. Games are good. There is no canteen in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, good placements, good infrastructure and good facilities .
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in the course /department is good in labs, classrooms, library. Wi-fi is available also. The quality of facilities in hostel is good also. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is good. Medical, sports and games faculty members are too good also.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college for studies.
reviews.review_text: There is greenary all around.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good teaching staff.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a separate block for the PG department. Discipline is maintained in classrooms and outside the classrooms. Our campus is very clean. Havan is also performed daily at 8:30 AM to aware the children of Vedic culture.

reviews.review_heading: It's the best college in Amritsar with efficient faculty members. Placements are rated 10 out of 10.
reviews.review_text: Our college has fully air-conditioned labs, spacious classrooms and a sitting area. The infrastructure of the college is superb. It is the best college in Amritsar. Cafeteria, cleaning and drinking facilities are available here. The hostel provides hygienic food to students along with full security.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Amritsar to opt for computer studies.
reviews.review_text: Our college has well-equipped and maintained computer labs and libraries. You can take benefit of all the basic facilities like parking, canteens, book shop, gym and playground.

reviews.review_heading: I had the best college life.
reviews.review_text: The quality of infrastructure is well-maintained. Wi-Fi facility is available in all departments. There is open access to the library and computer labs. The hostel is quite well-maintained with good quality food. Open and free medical facilities are available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with the college. The teaching pedagogy is also very old fashioned.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is good but the hostel is not at all good they even do not allow the students to go out even in the morning and mess food is also very bad. Although they have 3-4 canteens and food is good l. There is no Wi-Fi facility available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Teachers were acquainted with practical knowledge of the subjects. Good and satisfactory college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college was really very nice. Classrooms were well designed and were fully ventilated. Each department was having their own labs. Library of the college was also very nice and was fully air conditioned. College was fully equipped with the advanced gadgets.

reviews.review_heading: Really good placement number. Infrastructure and facilities are also good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of college is good. Classrooms library and labs are also well structured. The hostel facility provided by college is also satisfactory. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is also good. A good platform for the sports students.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, staff and very good facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good with very clean surroundings. Laboratories are very clean and big. The library is very good, and medical facilities are the best. Games are very entertaining, and I like our PT teacher. The canteen at our college is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty with great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There is no AC classrooms, wi-fi facility is not provided by the college and classrooms are spacious enough according to the strength of the class. Library is quite good it contains all the books related to the course. Hostel is good and the food provided in the mess is also good in quality. The medical room is there in the campus. Gym is there in the campus itself. Canteen 's food quality is also good.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because of very few faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the BBK DAV College for Women is good. However, the commerce department is not so good. Classrooms are small, and there is no proper ventilation. There are at least 50 students in each class. Only one washroom is available in the department. The library available is good.

individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good for the students.

content.Placements: Software developers get the highest and lowest packages offered in this course, which are 21,002 and 25,000. review_summary.college_name: Dr. N.G.P. Arts and Science College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in Coimbatore.

content.Placements: Many IT companies like Accenture, Wipro, and TCS visited the campus. There was a placement platform for the students. Many top companies came, and students who got jobs were happy and enjoyed their work. They were in good positions.
content.Infrastructure: The college had a library, labs, and good classrooms. I was not a hostel student. I was a day scholar, and it was awesome. I heard from hostel students in my classroom that there were many games and sports, annual day celebrations, fests, and many other activities in the college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am highly satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: About 70 out of 100 percent of students got placed. I think the highest salary offered is around Rs. 50,000 per month, and the minimum salary offered is Rs. 15,000 per month, based on their work and dedication. It is compulsory for each student to complete or undergo internships at a company, and it is compulsory for every student.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides proper and hygienic hostels. It has a good library, and a digital library is also available. In the case of facilities, everything is top-notch as compared to other colleges around Coimbatore. It also provides free Wi-Fi and digital libraries free of cost.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good college because of faculty and lab facilities.

content.Placements: 50% to 70% of students get placed in reputed companies. Taking a look at biotech companies, the opportunities are fewer. The biotechnology course in NGP is good, looking into the curriculum, and experiential learning. Biotech students are asked to attend an internship of one month for hands-on training.
content.Infrastructure: The biotechnology curriculum and laboratory are good. You would get experiential learning in labs, and various instrumentation is available to help students learn more. Canteens are also available in colleges, and non-vegetarian food is also provided. The snacks taste really good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is 7 out of 10, but everything has its own pros and cons, so you’ve to learn how to survive.

content.Placements: My college students are so kind and supportive of us, sharing their experiences on placements with us. Many people are getting placements happily. 80-90 percent of students were placed. TCS, Zoho, and Cognizant are the top recruiting companies for our course.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a lot of facilities. We can have the respected Wi-Fi, labs, and library time. Recently, our college time has changed, and we are getting a lot of time to explore our campus. The food is great, and we get equal and tasty food on campus at a cheap rate.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college.

content.Placements: 90% of students get placed in my college. The highest package is 12 LPA and the average package is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon, IBM, Cognizant, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, TCL, etc. Many students got internships in top product companies. Roles like software developer, human resource development, HR, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities available in the college are awesome. Classrooms are very clean and comfortable which makes students feel comfortable, healthy, and growing. The hostel will be in a neat state but we do not daily get non-veg so I have been given only 4 stars. Our college gives more importance to sports.

college_info.intro:
Amity University Jaipur through the Amity School of Architecture & Planning, Jaipur provides flagship BDes courses to students. Other popular programmes provided by the university are BTech and BSc. Amity University Jaipur Design students are taught Design Fundamentals, the History of Art and Design, and various other relevant subjects. Amity Jaipur Design students can work as Graphic Designers, Interior Designers, or can take up any field relevant to their stream.
Amity University Jaipur BTech students can work in various non-technical fields such as marketing, customer service, sales, and others. Overall, it is one of the top-ranked universities present in India. BTech, BSc, and other course students are placed in top companies such as Amazon, HCL, Airtel, TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, Wipro, and others. reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Realistic review of B.A. LL.B. at Amity University Jaipur

review_content.Placements: The B.A LL.B. course in this university was one of the best among the universities of Jaipur. Amity University Jaipur was a very good college and gave many opportunities to students. Around 70% chance of getting placed in B.A. LL.B. As far as I knew, the highest placement in B.A. LL.B. was about 45 LPA, and recently it went up to 52 LPA, while the lowest package was around 4–5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities I got in my course and on the campus were very nice, including classrooms and hostels. There was a separate library for law students with 24/7 Wi-Fi. The hostels were very good. Facilities provided were also nice. There were three messes on campus and many food outlets where students enjoyed their food. Medical facilities were available 24/7, and all types of sports facilities were present where students could utilize their energy.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in Applied Psychology (Honurs/ Research) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: My Amity University campus and academic review.

review_content.Placements: Amity generally gets good placement drive participation. Many big recruiters like Amazon, TCS, IBM, Capgemini, etc, visit campus, and for B.Tech 2025. The highest package is 35.9 LPA, while the average is 9.6 LPA, and the median is 6 LPA. That said, placement outcomes vary widely by course branch.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus generally offers modern classrooms, good labs and full campus-wide Wi-Fi, which supports academic excellence for technical professional courses. There are well-equipped laboratories and a large, well-stocked library. Hostels are separate for boys and girls, with options like single, double, and triple sharing. There is reasonably good infrastructure for core courses. Labs, library, classroom and campus facilities generally get positive marks in several reviews.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: One of the best colleges in Rajasthan for research studies.

review_content.Placements: 90% placement students got placement in my course. The highest package offered was 20 LPA, the lowest being 4LPA, and the average was 5 LPA. Panacea Pharmaceuticals, Serum Institute, Biocon, etc, are some of the companies that actively recruit students from my course. 100% students got an internship from my course. The top role offered is an Associate Scientist.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities at Amity University, Jaipur, are top-notch. The laboratories, classrooms, and daily amenities are all very good. The laboratories are all equipped with the latest research instruments, which are crucial for my course. The hostel facilities are very good, providing basic amenities needed for students. The food is also very good and affordable for students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Bioinformatics - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It is absolutely worth every penny we are paying.

review_content.Placements: Actually, every senior from our college gets a placement. That is true, and the minimum LPA is about 5, which is good. At the beginning, companies like Deloitte and other companies, such as Omics, Logice, and Wipro, come for placement.
review_content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, including Wi-Fi, labs worth 2-3 lakhs, classrooms with projectors, and a library worth visiting. I suggest everyone at least visit the campus, which provides a positive vibe and is worth every bit. There are several programs ongoing.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in Film and Television Production - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Amity University rocks the stage.

review_content.Placements: 70% of students from my course get placements. The package offered in our course starts from a minimum of 30-40,000 to a maximum of 3-4 LPA. Top companies include T-Series, Zee Studios, Shemaroo, Netflix, and Amazon, etc. 30% of students get internships at Zee Studios. The top roles offered are DOP, editor, director, and copywriter, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have a strong Wi-Fi connection, a folly studio, a recording studio, a computer lab, and well-cleaned, air-conditioned classrooms. We also have library support. The quality of the mess food was very good, and we have 24-hour medical support. We also have several sports and games available.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Cyber Security - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: This is the best university for the M.Sc. in Cyber Security Course.

review_content.Placements: The average placement rate for this session and the previous one was 90% in the Cyber Security Course. The highest bid was 25 LPA. The average salary was around 15-20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are DevsData LLC, Nexus IT Group, Alta Associates, etc. Top roles offered are Chief Information Security Officer, Security Architect, etc. More students are getting their internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: University areas, labs, classrooms, sports fields, and cafeterias are all equipped with Wi-Fi. The labs and classrooms are well-equipped with the latest equipment, projectors, mics, and good AC. The food there is good, if not the best, in terms of taste and hygiene. Hostel rooms are spacious and have LAN and Wi-Fi. Initially, the cooling water caused a scarcity of drinking water, but now, slowly, the problem has been solved.

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Jaipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Realistic review of B.A. LL.B. at Amity University Jaipur

content.Placements: The B.A LL.B. course in this university was one of the best among the universities of Jaipur. Amity University Jaipur was a very good college and gave many opportunities to students. Around 70% chance of getting placed in B.A. LL.B. As far as I knew, the highest placement in B.A. LL.B. was about 45 LPA, and recently it went up to 52 LPA, while the lowest package was around 4–5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities I got in my course and on the campus were very nice, including classrooms and hostels. There was a separate library for law students with 24/7 Wi-Fi. The hostels were very good. Facilities provided were also nice. There were three messes on campus and many food outlets where students enjoyed their food. Medical facilities were available 24/7, and all types of sports facilities were present where students could utilize their energy.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Applied Psychology (Honurs/ Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My Amity University campus and academic review.

content.Placements: Amity generally gets good placement drive participation. Many big recruiters like Amazon, TCS, IBM, Capgemini, etc, visit campus, and for B.Tech 2025. The highest package is 35.9 LPA, while the average is 9.6 LPA, and the median is 6 LPA. That said, placement outcomes vary widely by course branch.
content.Infrastructure: The campus generally offers modern classrooms, good labs and full campus-wide Wi-Fi, which supports academic excellence for technical professional courses. There are well-equipped laboratories and a large, well-stocked library. Hostels are separate for boys and girls, with options like single, double, and triple sharing. There is reasonably good infrastructure for core courses. Labs, library, classroom and campus facilities generally get positive marks in several reviews.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges in Rajasthan for research studies.

content.Placements: 90% placement students got placement in my course. The highest package offered was 20 LPA, the lowest being 4LPA, and the average was 5 LPA. Panacea Pharmaceuticals, Serum Institute, Biocon, etc, are some of the companies that actively recruit students from my course. 100% students got an internship from my course. The top role offered is an Associate Scientist.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities at Amity University, Jaipur, are top-notch. The laboratories, classrooms, and daily amenities are all very good. The laboratories are all equipped with the latest research instruments, which are crucial for my course. The hostel facilities are very good, providing basic amenities needed for students. The food is also very good and affordable for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Bioinformatics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is absolutely worth every penny we are paying.

content.Placements: Actually, every senior from our college gets a placement. That is true, and the minimum LPA is about 5, which is good. At the beginning, companies like Deloitte and other companies, such as Omics, Logice, and Wipro, come for placement.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, including Wi-Fi, labs worth 2-3 lakhs, classrooms with projectors, and a library worth visiting. I suggest everyone at least visit the campus, which provides a positive vibe and is worth every bit. There are several programs ongoing.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Film and Television Production - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Amity University rocks the stage.

content.Placements: 70% of students from my course get placements. The package offered in our course starts from a minimum of 30-40,000 to a maximum of 3-4 LPA. Top companies include T-Series, Zee Studios, Shemaroo, Netflix, and Amazon, etc. 30% of students get internships at Zee Studios. The top roles offered are DOP, editor, director, and copywriter, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We have a strong Wi-Fi connection, a folly studio, a recording studio, a computer lab, and well-cleaned, air-conditioned classrooms. We also have library support. The quality of the mess food was very good, and we have 24-hour medical support. We also have several sports and games available.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Amity  University  Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Yes, Amity Jaipur provides direct admission to candidates fufiling the below-mentioned criteria:Candidates must pass Class 12 (CBSE/ ISC/ State Boards) with at least 80% aggregate for direct admission to UG courses. After completion of selection rounds, candidates need to pay MBA fee.

reviews.review_heading: Realistic review of B.A. LL.B. at Amity University Jaipur
reviews.review_text: Facilities I got in my course and on the campus were very nice, including classrooms and hostels. There was a separate library for law students with 24/7 Wi-Fi. The hostels were very good. Facilities provided were also nice. There were three messes on campus and many food outlets where students enjoyed their food. Medical facilities were available 24/7, and all types of sports facilities were present where students could utilize their energy.

reviews.review_heading: My Amity University campus and academic review.
reviews.review_text: The campus generally offers modern classrooms, good labs and full campus-wide Wi-Fi, which supports academic excellence for technical professional courses. There are well-equipped laboratories and a large, well-stocked library. Hostels are separate for boys and girls, with options like single, double, and triple sharing. There is reasonably good infrastructure for core courses. Labs, library, classroom and campus facilities generally get positive marks in several reviews.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in Rajasthan for research studies.
reviews.review_text: The facilities at Amity University, Jaipur, are top-notch. The laboratories, classrooms, and daily amenities are all very good. The laboratories are all equipped with the latest research instruments, which are crucial for my course. The hostel facilities are very good, providing basic amenities needed for students. The food is also very good and affordable for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely worth every penny we are paying.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available, including Wi-Fi, labs worth 2-3 lakhs, classrooms with projectors, and a library worth visiting. I suggest everyone at least visit the campus, which provides a positive vibe and is worth every bit. There are several programs ongoing.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University rocks the stage.
reviews.review_text: We have a strong Wi-Fi connection, a folly studio, a recording studio, a computer lab, and well-cleaned, air-conditioned classrooms. We also have library support. The quality of the mess food was very good, and we have 24-hour medical support. We also have several sports and games available.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best university for the M.Sc. in Cyber Security Course.
reviews.review_text: University areas, labs, classrooms, sports fields, and cafeterias are all equipped with Wi-Fi. The labs and classrooms are well-equipped with the latest equipment, projectors, mics, and good AC. The food there is good, if not the best, in terms of taste and hygiene. Hostel rooms are spacious and have LAN and Wi-Fi. Initially, the cooling water caused a scarcity of drinking water, but now, slowly, the problem has been solved.

reviews.review_heading: Some faculty are good, and some are average.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average for now. Last semester, there were many instruments that were not available in the lab, and the classroom chairs were broken. Wi-Fi is good, medical facilities are also good, and at the university level, there are many sports clubs that a student can join.

reviews.review_heading: Best infrastructure college in Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very organized and beautifully blends with nature. The facilities are also good, like 5G Wi-Fi, lecture rooms with built-in projectors, and an excellent library that provides computers to students for study. Students just have to log in with their user ID.

reviews.review_heading: Have to think twice about the academic quality provided by the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure provided by the department are so far good. The facilities include Wi-Fi access all over the campus, one student can only connect 2 devices to the Wi-Fi, and drinking water. Washrooms are available on every floor. Hostel facility is also good. Wardens are quite strict and discipline is mandatory. The quality of the food is also impressive. Amity provides different kinds of sports such as cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, etc. There is a clinic on the campus ...

reviews.review_heading: Till now, the experience is good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good. We have proper labs, and there are separate labs for each language. To be honest, the hostel facilities are up to the mark, but the food quality is not up to the mark. So, you can avoid the mess food sometimes. We have multiple outlets, which also provide multiple food.

reviews.review_heading: This is an average college.
reviews.review_text: I would say the infrastructure here is average not too good but not shabby either. This college has a coupon system so don't fall for a cheap hostel fee, your money gets pretty drained here. The mess food is average too not good but not bad either except some days.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good and the best college.
reviews.review_text: Everything is going well here. Our faculty is friendly and approachable, and the departments have well-equipped labs. The hostels are clean, and the infrastructure of the buildings is very strong. The food quality in the mess and canteen is hygienic, and the medical facilities are excellent. Additionally, sports and games are prioritized and well-supported.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for B.Tech biotech.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities are provided inside the hostel. Classrooms are also very nice. They have centralized air conditioning in the class. In hostel, they provide AC and non-AC rooms. Our hostel rooms are average in size. We have Nescafe inside the hostel and vending machines so that we can access snacks and food at night. Classrooms are big and they have projectors.

reviews.review_heading: Amity is a beautiful and sustainable campus.
reviews.review_text: My course provides well-rounded labs with major industrial machines like bioreactors (50L), freeze dryers, SEM, etc. The infrastructure of the building is good with Wi-Fi connectivity all over the campus. We have a government-sponsored project in my course too. Hostels are well-equipped with every necessity including Wi-Fi 24x7, water cooler, and laundry. We have different options for mess which students can choose according to their will. We have a dedicated medical emergency room for any kind ...

reviews.review_heading: Amity is humongous in terms of opportunities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college campus is really good. The campus is humongous and astonishing. Our college has huge fields which are full of trees and greenery. It's quite peaceful and lovely to sit on the ground in the evening. Our course is really helping me a lot in understanding the subjects and maintaining my knowledge of the trends in the market. It will obviously help me in the future, as I will be up to date with the future market trends and placements.

review_content.Placements: The final year students are offered jobs from various companies with a minimum package of 2 to 3 Lacs per annum. reviews_list.review_title: Best college in Jalandhar for girls as it is not a Co-Ed college.

review_content.Placements: Many companies come to our college and select students and give them the best placements with the best salary packages but I never ever applied for any placements. Mostly, 40–50% of the students apply for the placements and get selected. The students will be selected on a merit basis and based on their performance.
review_content.Infrastructure: All the infrastructure of our college is not up to par, but if you look at the fee structure of a college, then at that price, the college's first structure is not bad. All the quality of the food is very good, the canteen is very neat and clean and there are many sports and game facilities. All though our classes are not air conditioned, all the labs and libraries are fully air conditioned.

review_summary.college_name: Hans Raj Mahila Maha Vidyalaya Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Voc. in Cosmetology and Wellness - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: M.Voc. cosmetology course admission, 2026.

content.Placements: Approximately 70% of students found employment. The lowest package is about 2.5 LPA, the highest is about 6 LPA, and the average is about 4 LPA. Cosmetic brands, wellness chains, and beauty salons are among the recruiters. Salon and skincare companies offered internships. However, there aren't many worldwide opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, a library with cosmetology resources, and contemporary skincare and haircare equipment are all features of the labs. The hostel is fine, but there isn't much variety in the food. There are sports and medical facilities, but the upkeep of the hostel needs to be improved.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Economics - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: Placements of the college are average. All the placements of individual courses are conducted like commerce, fashion designing, computer science, etc. The faculty who arrange the placement drive are supportive and commendably amazing encourage us to take part in drives and encourage us to get selected.
content.Infrastructure: The course is no doubt world-class and competitive to any international school. The hostel of my college is good. The hostel is clean. All the rooms are well-furnished. Hostels are the USP of my college. Freshers and farewells are organized in the hostel for the enjoyment of the boarders as well. The school even has internationally renowned visiting faculty who train us on the most recent research topics. Courses like environment, development economics, game theory, and industrial economics are some of the value-added subjects along with the specialization in econometrics give a competitive advantage to students.

content.Placements: Many companies come to our college and select students and give them the best placements with the best salary packages but I never ever applied for any placements. Mostly, 40–50% of the students apply for the placements and get selected. The students will be selected on a merit basis and based on their performance.
content.Infrastructure: All the infrastructure of our college is not up to par, but if you look at the fee structure of a college, then at that price, the college's first structure is not bad. All the quality of the food is very good, the canteen is very neat and clean and there are many sports and game facilities. All though our classes are not air conditioned, all the labs and libraries are fully air conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing with good staff and infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good facilities and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The canteen is available in more numbers, and different types of snacks and lunch are provided at an affordable rate. Medical facilities are good. In sports, a separate department is allotted for that. A new ground is built for student use and is used well.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the education.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Labs are well-equipped with many equipment and also smart board is provided for every class. Library is accessible upto 7:00 PM. About canteen, there are many canteens. SKASC also priorities sports and extracurricular activities that can boost the mind.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very neat and attractive. Wi-Fi is always available and labs are well-maintained. Classrooms are very neat with smart board and hostel facilities are good with emergency ambulance facilities and canteen is around the college.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied because of good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Labs are maintained well and classrooms are neat. Library is accessible to everyone and hostel provides good food and cleanliness. About games we can participate in any events and the Wi-Fi connection is available through the campus and labs are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college but the fee is high.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is great and beautiful. The college is full of greenish places and well-maintained. The college has one of the best infrastructure in Coimbatore. The hostel is good. The food served in the hostel is not good. They serve full vegetarian items.

HITSCAT is the new entrance test conducted by the institute for admission to BDes, Law, Management, and some other courses. Additionally, some national entrance exams are also accepted for admission. These include UGC NET, CLAT, and GATE. Apart from this, the university also has a Centre for Open and Digital Education where six courses are taught online including both UG and PG level courses. Hindustan University courses offered include UG, PG, Doctoral, and Integrated courses in popular streams. These are BCom, BBA, BCA, MA, MBA, and MCA.

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS) has a multi-step admission process that students need to follow to get into the university. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the entrance exam followed by selection rounds and lastly confirmation of admission. After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the university. Interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Additionally, Admission to all the programmes is based on the entrance exam. Check below the complete HITS admission process:
1 - HITS Application 2025
The mode of application is online. Candidates must register online and then fill out the online application form.
2 - HITS Admission Selection rounds
Appear for the university-based entrance exam i.e., HITSEEE & HITSCAT. The selection will be based on entrance exam score and GDPI and then wait for the release of their merit list.
3 - HITS Document Verification
Once the selection rounds are done, the shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: What is the fees of Hindustan University for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the BTech course ranges between INR 1.8 Lakhs to INR 13 lakhs. Apart from this, the candidate also has to pay hostel and one-time fee to pursue BTech course at Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science commonly known as Hindustan University.

faqs.question: What is the fee for LLB at Hindustan University?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for LLB courses at Hindustan University is INR 5 lakh. Candidates also have to pay tutition fee and hostel fee. Note: This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for MBA at HITS Chennai?
faqs.answer: The total fee for HITS Chennai MBA courses is cumulative of multiple components, such as security deposit, tuition fee, hostel fee, and more. Selected candidates have to pay admission fee amount after selection for seat confirmation. Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science MBA tuition fee range from INR 1.2 Lacs to INR 4.3 lakh . Additionally, the one-time fee is INR 8,500 and the hostel charges range from INR 1.48 Lacs to INR 1.64 lakh . It must be noted that the mentioned fee is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

hostel.description:
The hostels have well-furnished air-conditioned and regular rooms with attached restrooms providing the right ambience for the students. There are five residential halls for boys and three for girls on campus
that accommodate over 2500 students. State of the art kitchen and spacious dining area has been provided for both the hostels and a customized menu caters to the student’s needs. Hygiene and cleanliness is emphasized in the hostel. All the hostels offer a variety of services and opportunities for students. Staff members residing in the hostel are assigned to address academic and personal problems of the students. Round-the-clock security, communication, dispensary facilities are also available.

paragraphs: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science offers both need-based and merit-based scholarships to the eligible students. Also, Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science has instituted Hindustan Teaching Research Fellowships (HTRF) for eligible candidates.
Below are the major highlights of Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science scholarships:

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science provides a total of 7 scholarships to eligible students. Below mentioned are the detailed information regarding Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science scholarships:
DRDO Scholarship Scheme for Girls

This scholarship is for Girls / Women students studying in first year of Under Graduate (BE/B.TECH: full time four year degree) and Post Graduate (M.TECH/ME: two year full time degree course) under “DRDO Scholarship Scheme for Girls in Aerospace Engg / Aeronautical Engg / Space Engg & Rocketry / Avionics / Aircraft Engg”.
Covid Martyrs Scholarships

This scholarship is for wards of COVID Martyrs, who have lost their lives protecting our countrymen during the COVID Pandemic will be given complete Tuition Fee waiver in the discipline of their choice, having met the basic laid down norms, such as marks in qualifying exams etc. Also all the expenses of the student which include traveling, boarding and lodging will be taken care of by HITS. Also, a monthly stipend is provided during the period of the course.
Covid Frontline Warrior Scholarship

This scholarship is for the wards of Doctors, Healthcare professionals, Government and Service personnel those who have participated in protecting our countrymen during the COVID Pandemic. The scholarship is for a period of two years across all courses to those who meet the basic scholarship criteria.
Dr KCG Verghese Merit Cum Means Scholarship

This scholarship is offered to the top scorers in Class 12 from any School, Boards, Subjects, Centum Scorers, Class Toppers at HITS, Batch Toppers, and UG Rank Holders and Proficiency Prize holders are awarded scholarship to pursue their higher studies at HITS. Scholarships are also awarded to the meritorious students who are financially weak to meet their educational needs at HITS.
Dr Elizabeth Verghese Founder Chancellor Scholarship

This scholarship is offered to the girls with academic potential to pursue higher education and who are from lower income families and are interested in pursuing higher education at HITS are eligible for this scholarship.
Hindusthan Loyality Scholarship
This scholarship is subject to norms and the scrutiny of the Scholarship Committee. It is offered to:
Sports Scholarship

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science offers this scholarship to the students who excel in sports. The student who has performed and achieved at the National, State and Inter-University Levels in the following sports are eligible.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely fantastic college and campus life to enjoy, and a perfect placement ratio.

review_content.Placements: The total number of students in B.Tech CSE is almost 1500. So a minimum of 100 to 120 students is selected. The highest package is 23 Lacs, the average package is 6-7 Lacs, and the lowest package is 2-3 Lacs. The above details are based on campus placement records. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and HCL Technologies. In our college, internships start from the 6th semester, and mainly they are with local companies based in Jaipur. Almost 20 to 30% of students get internships, mainly for data analyst positions.
review_content.Infrastructure: In the first year, you explore various types of labs like electrical, electronics, CADD, Python, C lab, workshop, Physics lab, Chemistry lab, etc. From the second year, all your classes are held in lab rooms, and you get a personal desktop for all your classes. Hostel accommodation is very good; there are four hostels on our campus and also four hostels outside the campus. The mess is in a very large area on our campus, and there are two big mess halls with a capacity of a minimum of 800 students eating at a time. In a day, meals are served four times. Hostel life is very good on campus with free Wi-Fi, laundry, sports coaches, a gym, etc.

reviews_list.review_title: Poornima University: Best college for placements and learning.

admission_process.title: Poornima University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Poornima University admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts its own entrance exam as well as accepts national-level entrance exams like NATA, UGC NET etc. for providing admission to specific courses.Poornima Universityoffers over 92 courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in multiple streams like Engineering, Management, Design, Architecture, etc. through nine faculties. Candidates can apply online or offline for Poornima University course admissions.
Poornima University Admission Open:Apply Now

Poornima University admissions are open online. Candidates need to fulfil the eligibility and selection criteria to take admission to any of the UG or PG programmes. Find below the key highlights for Poornima University admissions:

Candidates can get admission to UG courses only if they have completed Class 12. Graduation is the minimum required to get admission to PG courses. The selection criteria will differ course-wise. Poornima University admission processincludes multiple steps. Aspirants need to begin with filling the application form. The selection will be either based on merit or an entrance exam. Find below the step-wise admission process for Poornima University:
STEP 1: Poornima University Application Process 2025

Candidates can apply online or offline for any of the UG or PG programmes of Poornima University. Candidates need to pay an application fee ofINR 1,500. Aspirants need to fill out the form and submit it along with the specified documents.
STEP 2: Selection Process

Poornima University selects candidates based on merit for most of the programmes. For BBA (Hons), and BCom (Hons), the university conducts a written test to shortlisted candidates for admission. The national-level entrance exams such asNATA,UGC NETare also accepted for admission to specific courses. Selected candidates might also need to come for a personal interview round for some courses.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
After completion of all the selection rounds, candidates receive an offer letter. Selected aspirants are required to pay the course fee to confirm their admission in the university.

A pass in three-year UG degree with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST/ non-creamy layer OBC/ SBC/ Girls) is required to apply for MBA courses. Candidates must pass UG degree or equivalent with at least 55% aggregate to apply for MBA Sustainability & Entrepreneurship.

faqs.answer: MBA is a two-year course divided into four semesters. Poornima University offers MBA in two specialisations through the Faculty of Management & Commerce. The university offers admission to MBA based on merit in the last qualifying exam. Poornima University conducts an entrance exam for an MBA Sustainability & Entrepreneurship. Selected candidates are further called for a personal interview round.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MBA at Poornima University?
faqs.answer: A pass in three-year UG degree with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST/ non-creamy layer OBC/ SBC/ Girls) is required to apply for MBA courses. faqs.question: How many seats are available for the MBA programme at Poornima University?
faqs.answer: Poornima University in Jaipur, Rajasthan, has 94 programmes available, including an MBA. This college provides the 2 years of  MBA course for the students.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for MBA at Poornima University?
faqs.answer: A bachelor's degree in any area with a minimum of 48% marks is required for admission to the MBA programme at Poornima University. The minimum for ST/SC/OBC/SBC is 45%. The programme lasts two years. Direct admission is possible if one's graduation grade point average is more than 65%. If a student's grade point average falls below 60%, they must take an entrance exam.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Poornima University?
faqs.answer: Poornima University admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The university selects candidates based on merit for most of the programmes. For BBA (Hons), BCom (Hons), Poornima University conducts a written test to shortlist candidates for admission. faqs.question: What is the admission process of Poornima University?
faqs.answer: Poornima University admission process begins with registration. Eligible candidates need to pay an application fee of INR 1,500. Aspirants need to fill out the form and submit it along with the specified documents. Poornima University shortlists candidates based on merit for most of the programmes. For BBA (Hons), BCom (Hons), the university conducts a written test to shortlisted candidates for admission.After completion of all the selection rounds, candidates receives an offer letter. Selected aspirants are required to pay the course fee to confirm their admission to the university.

faqs.question: Can I fill the NCHMCT JEE application form offline?
faqs.answer: No, candidates cannot fill out the NCHMCT JEE application form offline. The exam authority for theNational Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology (NCHMCT) JEE examreleases the NCHMCT JEE application form online only.The exam is conducted for all eligible candidates from different Indian states. It is difficult for the exam authority to make the exam form available to everyone at different physical application centres. Thus, to allow all the exam aspirants to access the NCHMCT JEE application form, the exam authority makes it available online on the National Testing Agency's NCHMCT JEE official website of,nchm.nta.nic.in. The NCHMCT JEE application or registration form can also be accessed on the website of National Council For Hotel Management And Catering Technology,nchmct.info.

reviews.review_heading: Modern campus, good learning.
reviews.review_text: My university offers modern infrastructure with well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, libraries, and sports facilities. It provides multiple courses like B.Tech, MBA, BVA, BBA, and design, along with a comfortable hostel featuring Wi-Fi, mess, sports, and many gardens.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely fantastic college and campus life to enjoy, and a perfect placement ratio.
reviews.review_text: In the first year, you explore various types of labs like electrical, electronics, CADD, Python, C lab, workshop, Physics lab, Chemistry lab, etc. From the second year, all your classes are held in lab rooms, and you get a personal desktop for all your classes. Hostel accommodation is very good; there are four hostels on our campus and also four hostels outside the campus. The mess is in a very large area on our campus, and there are two big mess halls with a capacity of a minimum of 800 student...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure facilities not satisfied with placements.
reviews.review_text: The university provides Wi-Fi in each and every PC. Labs are excellent with AC and projectors. Classrooms are also very nice. Infrastructure is excellent. Food in hostel is average or above average we can say. Canteen is also there, sports facility is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Poornima University: Best college for placements and learning.
reviews.review_text: The campus covers 32 acres and features cutting-edge ICT-enabled classrooms with Wi-Fi, LAN, and projectors. Seminar halls, auditoriums, and multimedia-equipped lecture rooms support conferences, workshops, and cultural events. The central library offers over 2400 volumes, a wide range of journals, and access to IEEE, DELNET, and other digital resources for engineering, management, architecture, and IT programs. Hostels are located on campus with secure access, providing accommodation for both b...

reviews.review_heading: It's all good and the best.
reviews.review_text: All good, but need to be better, and one thing which I also notice is that it's improving day by day. The management also saw that they needed to improve, so they implemented the procedure, and they are trying their best, but the quality in the hostel is, although good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied, and good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are very good for my course. We have Wi-Fi connections, computer labs with good working systems, and a library with many reference and other books. The facilities in the hostel are good. As I am not from the hostel, I have heard from my friends that the food quality, sports and games, and medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and supportive faculty, with vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course at Poornima University is quite modern, with a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, well-equipped computer labs, digital classrooms, and a central library that provides access to both books and e-resources. The hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and 24/7 security.

reviews.review_heading: Good for the economic family.
reviews.review_text: Almost everything is available here; sometimes you find it sufficient, sometimes not. Almost, they have all the things that you want, not so, but so. They have a gym, football ground, American football ground, and central park; it's like a semi-event area, and currently, they are expanding their campus and infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The college is average and not worth as per the fee it charges.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities require significant improvement. Washrooms are hygienic and poorly maintained, which affects daily comfort and sanitation. Additionally, the Wi-Fi connectivity is unreliable, disrupting online activities and communication. The quality of food provided is also subpar and lacks consistency in taste and nutrition. Overall, these issues impact the living experience and need immediate attention.

reviews.review_heading: Poornima University - Just another tier 3 college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch. AC computer labs are assigned in place of traditional lecture halls. Every student has their own assigned PC. Talking about mess, food is satisfactory and quality and hygiene are maintained well. Sports exposure is great too, regular trials are conducted for university teams. Campus has courts for sports like tennis, pickleball, football, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with the environment and fests. Infrastructure development is a little annoying.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is good, but the food in the mess is below average. However, overall it can be taken. I can't comment on hygiene, as the food is prepared elsewhere and then brought to the college. The classrooms are good, and the big library is pretty good.

reviews.review_heading: I opted for this college because of good and helpful faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Everything is perfect; the lab is well-equipped, with excellent air conditioning. The teachers are good, and the hostel is satisfactory, though the student population is a concern. All sports are available, such as cricket, tennis, basketball, etc., and I am happy to recommend them.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with my college as it has good faculty members and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available is good. Labs are too good with AC, and the new block and open stage stadium are being created.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with infrastructure and faculty. Great learning, average placements, and fun events.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are best for girls, especially since rooms are highly maintained. The washrooms are super clean. However, the boys' hostel is not the same as the girls, their washrooms are not in healthy condition. The mess food is average. The medical facilities are the best. They provide sports activities in the evening, which are open to hostellers and day scholars.

reviews.review_heading: Best private college within budget with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: There is a dedicated computer lab for the whole day for B.Tech, BCA, and MCA students. Classrooms are pretty decent, and the academic block is nice. There is a need for improvement in hostel food and infrastructure. There is serious development and construction ongoing to make a new academic building and hostel.

placements.overview:
CT Institute of Hospitality Management is a private institute and is located in Jalandhar, Punjab. CT Institute of Hospitality Management courses are offered to students at the UG and PG levels. The institute is approved by AICTE and offers courses in Full Time mode. CT Institute of Hospitality Management offers a total of 8 courses in streams such as Design, Hospitality & Travel and Aviation. Some of the popular courses offered at the institute are B.Sc., BHMCT, UG Diploma and MHMTT and the total seat intake for the available courses is 450. These courses are offered to students across several specialisations such as Fashion Design, Food Production and Travel & Tourism Management. Further, the fee for all these courses ranges between INR 46,000 to 2,40,000 and the average median salary is around INR 2,62,833. Apart from this, the CT Institute of Hospitality Management campus has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with all the advanced facilities.

Candidates seeking admission to the programmes offered by the institute can apply online. The application form is available on the official website of the institute. The candidates can fill and submit the same before the last date. CT Institute of Hospitality Management admission is merit-based.

reviews.review_heading: Good and worthy college for students.
reviews.review_text: It has a central library with huge collection of books and Wi-Fi connectivity across the campus. Hostel facilities is also here for both boys and girls with good condition rooms, hygienic food and regular cleaning facilities. There is an auditorium as well.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life and crowd.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with the best infrastructure and facilities any college could ever provide. We have classrooms that are very neat, clean and air-conditioned. We have a library and a computer lab where students can spend their day.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are commendable. All the classrooms are air-conditioned. We also have computer labs and an auditorium where we take sessions regularly. There is a canteen on the campus where nutritious food is provided.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CT Institute of Hotel Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is beautiful. The campus is lush green and very beautiful. The hostel facility provided by the college is also awesome, and there are two separate buildings for both boys and girls. The warden of the hostel is also a caretaker. Practical labs are awesome.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college is really commendable as the campus life is great and the crowd is great too. The infrastructure for our course is brilliant. All the classrooms are air conditioned. We also have a library where children can read anything they want and 1 canteen is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good infrastructure, and it is developing.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is commendable, and every student enjoys campus life. Students can easily adjust here. Quality of the food served in the canteen is very good and nutritious. Our college also provides a library and computer labs.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CT Institute of Hotel Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is beautiful and the labs are very spacious and pretty much good. The college provides hostel facilities for both and girls and boys in different buildings. The food served in the mess is also good. Canteen also serves pretty much hygienic food.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college and every student gets placed and even teachers are so helpful.
reviews.review_text: We have many practical labs with full equipment for practical knowledge. They have a separate library for the HM holders. I am a day scholar, but my friends who stay in the hostel say that it is good. The mess is pretty awesome, and the canteen is the best part as there is a bakery inside the college. There are every sport and game in college. We even conduct half marathon.

reviews.review_heading: Really it is a excellent college for hotel management and all the teachers are well qualified.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities provided in our courses like computer labs, restaurants, bar, production labs, front office labs and housekeeping labs because they play a major role in our course. There is an average quality of food is provided in the hostel mess and there is every month very events are there in which every talent games are there.

reviews.review_heading: A way for the good future and the journey starts here.
reviews.review_text: The college had the very good infrastructure. There is a 24 hours Wi-Fi facility in the campus with very high-speed for hostelers also. There are proper labs for the practicals and different labs for every subject. There is a very good library. For entertainment, sports and games are there.

reviews.review_heading: Placement and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities of our college are very suitable to the students, and they are adopting it. All the classrooms and the corridor need are clean, and all the classrooms are fully air-conditioned. The canteen provides very nutritious food.

reviews.review_heading: I had a satisfying experience of education and extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our campus is well-organised. There are many facilities for students according to their fields, such as labs, seminar halls and playgrounds. Our field needs practical experience along with theoretical, and it is also provided within the campus.

college_info.intro:
The flagship programmes of JECRC University are its BTech, MTech and MBA courses being well sought-out among students for their flexibility when it comes to specialisations as well as the placement opportunities and career growth after graduation.
The JECRC University BTech covers 21+ specialisations with the programme having a focus on skill development and hands-on learning in a variety of technology focused disciplines.
While the JECRC University MBA imparts management techniques covering topics such as Business Analysis, HR, Finance, etc.
Also, the JECRC University MTech allows students to specialise deeper in their domain allowing students a fast-track to becoming industry experts
Apart from this, the JECRC University Vidhani also features a range of courses offered in distance mode of education through its Directorate of Distance Education. The courses are given in different specialisations, and students can open the university page to learn more about course-specific specialisations. review_content.Placements: Placements in JECRC University are around 90 percent. The highest package was 32 LPA in 2025, the lowest was 2-3 Lakhs, and the average package was 6.8 LPA.
