individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College life is good, however, the placements are not too good.

content.Placements: 10% classmates were placed in office companies, and the rest of them are jobless, doing jobs in BPOs and other fields like sales and marketing. So all average, the placements were not good. I also got my first interview cleared in a sales role, however, they don’t allow us to sit in other internships as one is cleared.
content.Infrastructure: The classroom and infrastructure were good. Labs and libraries were also fine. The canteen was good as well. Sports facilities were good. Medical facilities were also fine, everything was fine.
content.Faculty: Examinations were also average. Courses were not provided by the college. semester wise examining were not so hard, however, you will have to study by yourself, as the study material, like books and copies, was not included in the fees and not provided by the college, so be prepared.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college because it gives you an amazing college life.

content.Placements: I am a fresher, but as I see my seniors, in comparison to the rest of the colleges, it is far better. The placement statistics are for the batch of 2026. The highest package is INR 33-52 LPA. Average package is INR 6.67-6.8 LPA. As we see, college with this type of college life is crazy.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel food is average, but rooms are amazing, you get a private room even in a 3-sharing room, as the hostel is like a 3 BHK flat. You have a common room and a common bathroom, and you have full privacy. There are some strict rules in the hostel that are strictly followed. The labs are also well-maintained.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: JECRC University really has great infrastructure, and its main factor is the events it conducts.

content.Placements: Placements in JECRC University are around 90 percent. The highest package was 32 LPA in 2025, the lowest was 2-3 Lakhs, and the average package was 6.8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Deloitte, Microsoft, etc. Top roles offered were Data Scientists and software developers (both backend and frontend).
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of JECRC University is way better than other competing universities in Jaipur. Classrooms are fully furnished with power sockets inbuilt in each bench, Wi-Fi, AC installed in labs, and a dispensary for any medical emergency. The quality of food available in the hostel is not that good. The canteen has several outlets which have great taste, such as Domino's, etc. JECRC University has great sports infrastructure, from courts of individual to team sports to equipment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college is overall good, just I feel the campus is not so good like others.

content.Placements: I have started my B. Tech in 2024, and at that time the total placements from JECRC University and JECRC Foundation are around 2000 placements. In B. Tech, around 1000 students are placed from JECRC University, and around 75 percent of students from B. Tech got placement. The highest package is 50 LPA, the average is 6 to 7 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3.5–4 LPA. There are top recruiting companies like Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, Accenture, Infosys, Capgemini, Wipro, and the roles offered are software developer, software engineer, data scientist, data science analyst, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: JECRC files pros and cons.

content.Placements: The percentage of students is 40 to 50 percent who are placed. This year, the highest is, I guess, 33 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are HPE and Meta. For internships, the ratio is again low, it's 45 to 50 percent. The top role offered is an employee.
content.Infrastructure: I like the infrastructure, it's unique, and you'll definitely feel a friendly environment here. The mess food is good, and the classrooms are also good, kind of like a school vibe, but okay. Wi-Fi works fine, but they can still work on it. Sports facilities are quite good. We have volleyball football, cricket, basketball, tennis, badminton, and pickleball courts.

JECRC admission procedurestarts with filling out an application form for the desired course by applicants. To apply for admission, candidates must ensure that they are meeting the admission requirements set by the university. Below are the steps to get a seat in the university;
Step 1: JECRC University Application Process 2026

The mode of application is online. Candidates must fill out the application form on the university's website. Aspirants applying for a UG or a PG programme need to pay an application fee ofINR 850. The application fee for PhD programmes isINR 1,500.
Step 2: Selection

The university selects candidates for admission to most of the courses based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. JECRC University also considers scores CUET-UG and CUET-PG scores for some of the UG and PG programmes, respectively. The university also accepts JEE Main, CAT, MAT, etc. for admission to specific courses. Aspirants also need to further pass a personal interview round for courses such as BAJMC, Integrated Law, BA (Hons), etc.
Step 3: Final Admission
Selected candidates need to report at the campus for document verification. Further, aspirants need to pay theJECRC University feeto confirm their seat.

reviews.review_heading: College life is good, however, the placements are not too good.
reviews.review_text: The classroom and infrastructure were good. Labs and libraries were also fine. The canteen was good as well. Sports facilities were good. Medical facilities were also fine, everything was fine.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college because it gives you an amazing college life.
reviews.review_text: Hostel food is average, but rooms are amazing, you get a private room even in a 3-sharing room, as the hostel is like a 3 BHK flat. You have a common room and a common bathroom, and you have full privacy. There are some strict rules in the hostel that are strictly followed. The labs are also well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: JECRC University really has great infrastructure, and its main factor is the events it conducts.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of JECRC University is way better than other competing universities in Jaipur. Classrooms are fully furnished with power sockets inbuilt in each bench, Wi-Fi, AC installed in labs, and a dispensary for any medical emergency. The quality of food available in the hostel is not that good. The canteen has several outlets which have great taste, such as Domino's, etc. JECRC University has great sports infrastructure, from courts of individual to team sports to equipment.

reviews.review_heading: The college is overall good, just I feel the campus is not so good like others.
reviews.review_text: I am pursuing M.A. B. Tech in Computer Science. There are lots of well-working computer labs with decent Wi-Fi facilities for practice in university, clean and spacious classrooms for theory classes, multiple halls and auditoriums for seminars, and a silent library for studies with access to computers in the library. The hostel is well-structured. The best part about the hostel is that it has personal rooms, a good and proper attendance system, and a gym included in the boys’ hostel. The mess is...

reviews.review_heading: JECRC files pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: I like the infrastructure, it's unique, and you'll definitely feel a friendly environment here. The mess food is good, and the classrooms are also good, kind of like a school vibe, but okay. Wi-Fi works fine, but they can still work on it. Sports facilities are quite good. We have volleyball football, cricket, basketball, tennis, badminton, and pickleball courts.

reviews.review_heading: College is good if you are considering a good campus life with decent placements and a good crowd.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good, with good classes and all the available facilities one can look for. There is also a very big and recently opened canteen that has a lot of big fast food brands inside with good seating space. The hostels are also good with triple-sharing rooms.

reviews.review_heading: University life of a student.
reviews.review_text: Labs are air-conditioned, and proper PCs are available for each student. There are two main libraries for books, and students can borrow any book for a 15-day period and then have to return it, otherwise, a fine is to be paid. There's a cafeteria with various outlets that have recently opened, where students can sit and enjoy.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and faculty, with a good environment and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus was very large and far from the main city of Hyderabad, with bad transport facilities to the college. College hostels were messy, and the food was not good. Sports facilities were good. Wi-Fi was present but could not be accessed. Labs and classrooms were good.

reviews.review_heading: My overall experience is quite good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, but the speed is average and usable. There are labs for every specific subject. It has well-furnished classrooms. The library has a lot of books. Faculty members in the hostel are quite nice and help with every problem we face. Food is also good because it is managed by the Stanza Living company. Medical facilities are available for 24 hours. Sports facilities are really good. We have grounds and courts for every game.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Rajasthan and one of the best colleges in India. It is worth the money.
reviews.review_text: The department has high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, and access to a central library with good technical resources. Labs are updated regularly. The overall infrastructure is modern and student-friendly. The hostel is decent with clean rooms,  24x7 security, and regular housekeeping. The food quality and canteen are good and hygienic, with multiple food options. The campus has good medical facilities and a health centre. It has a good sports ground for cricket, foot...

reviews.review_heading: Everything works only if you hustle.
reviews.review_text: Fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus with decent internet speed. Classrooms are good. A library with books specially for law students. Mess food is better than average and managed by a hotel management company called Stanza Living, and it also has a cafeteria. 24/7 medical support with ambulance and dispensary. For sports, it has a football ground, cricket ground, tennis court, volleyball court, basketball court and football turf.

reviews.review_heading: The worst placement in private universities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, in fact hostels are also very good and environment of hostel is also very neat and clean. But the main problem is Wi-Fi. Like in classes you will definitely get the network issue and the faculty doesn't provide you the password of the floor Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with good facilities and amazing events.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well maintained with smart boards and benches with electric circuit with free Wi-Fi throughout the college. Every subject has its dedicated lab like Physics Chemistry and Computer programming. There are around 2 fully functioning libraries with proper facilities consisting of books for specialized courses. Hostel and mess facilities are excellent with a proper menu and air conditioned rooms 3 to 4 students in each room with their own partitioned cubicles.

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics - Poor control.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at JECRC University is impressive and student friendly. From spacious classrooms to good campus facilities, everything is well organised. The environment feels positive and supportive for academic purpose. This is a very nice thing of the college.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it was the best university for the MCA course.
reviews.review_text: Facilities at our campus were among my favourite things. Facility had air conditioning in a number of spaces, including the library and classrooms. Wi-Fi was also available at our college. The hostel boasted first-rate amenities and affordable pricing. The cafeteria was nice, stylish, and affordable.

DOT School of Design admissionsare primarily entrance-based. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at DOT School of Design is as per the steps below:

The mode of application is online. Aspirants need at the official website for admission to the various programme. Candidates can fill out the application form on the university's official website.
STEP 2: Selection
Students are selected based on Personal Interview and Portfolio Submission +DOT DAT for BDes and Personal interview, portfolio submission and DOT-DAT entrance exam for MDes course.
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

The institute also releases a merit list based on the composite score of the candidates for admission. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theDOT School of Design feeto confirm their seats in the university.

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Raipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) (Honours/ Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the campus is good.

content.Placements: The BBA course sees around 70 percent placements and roles, mainly in sales, business development, and HR. 80 percent of the students have secured internships in finance, marketing, and HR. Companies like Flipkart, Renault, etc., hire students for major roles like sales, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is totally good for the BBA and hostel, and the facilities provided are also good. Facilities in the hostel have been improved and now they take proper care of everything. There are useless restrictions that are imposed on students that need to be stopped.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The university has a great performance in Chhattisgarh.

content.Placements: Approximately 75% of students are placed at the university every year. The highest package goes across 30 LPA, and the lowest package goes across 8 LPA. The university provides different courses for the students to make their future bright as well, and the CRC department of the university is helpful for the students.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities at the university are excellent, like unlimited Wi-Fi, good furniture, an AC dining hall, a green campus, and good infrastructure. The classroom has ACs. There is a cleanliness on the campus, and it has a ragging-free atmosphere, is under CCTV surveillance, and provides medical facilities, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication (Honours/ Research) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great learning and experience from Amity.

content.Placements: The placements provided at Amity are good. Top media houses visited the campus for placement. The package ranges from 4-7 LPA. Many students from my batch went for higher education. Internship opportunities are provided to the students based on their interests and skills.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided for learning is excellent. The studio is equipped with all the necessary equipment for our learning. The classrooms have Wi-Fi. The library has books for all departments. It has computers for e-learning where students can access journals. The hostel facility is good. They provide two sharing rooms. There are 3 hostels currently. There are common rooms, game rooms, and a dance room for students' engagement. The mess area is quite big, accommodation for the students. The food provided is to suits everyone's taste. The medical staff is available for the students' help.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Well-structured curriculum and good placements.

content.Placements: In my batch out of the strength of 79 students, almost 40 percent of students got an on-campus placement with the highest offer of 19 LPA and an average of 5 LPA. 30 percent of students went for higher education. Top roles offered in our courses include Software Developer, Data Analyst, Software Engineer, etc. Recruiting companies include LearningRoutes, PlanetSpark, QSpiders, IBM, Genpact, and more.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, our college has a good infrastructure having all the required labs, with high-speed internet connections available for all the students. Our college has a wide range of books available in high-class libraries and has a vast collection of books, research papers, and digital resources. The hostel facilities are designed for our comfort and convenience, offering both AC and non-AC rooms with essential amenities like Wi-Fi, Laundry, and security.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B.(Hons.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Insight of Amity University Raipur.

content.Placements: My batch in total has 30 students. As we are freshers, we know about our seniors who have been placed in huge companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Google, etc. The average package is 500,000 per year, and the highest goes up to 2,500,000 or something. The lowest can be 200,000 per year to start, then it can increase according to your performance in the future.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided by the college is top-notch. The library has vast resources, fully equipped sports facilities, and well-maintained classrooms, making it a conducive environment for learning and recreation. The campus design, with its modern amenities and green spaces, ensures a balance between study and relaxation.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning and experience from Amity.

reviews.review_heading: Well-structured curriculum and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Overall, our college has a good infrastructure having all the required labs, with high-speed internet connections available for all the students. Our college has a wide range of books available in high-class libraries and has a vast collection of books, research papers, and digital resources. The hostel facilities are designed for our comfort and convenience, offering both AC and non-AC rooms with essential amenities like Wi-Fi, Laundry, and security.

reviews.review_heading: Insight of Amity University Raipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided by the college is top-notch. The library has vast resources, fully equipped sports facilities, and well-maintained classrooms, making it a conducive environment for learning and recreation. The campus design, with its modern amenities and green spaces, ensures a balance between study and relaxation.

reviews.review_heading: Details of Amity University, Raipur.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college is well-furnished with projectors and air-conditioned classrooms. In hostel, there are 3 rooms for 6 students sharing, one washroom and one bathroom. Mess is provided but not good in taste. The quality of food is bad. Although, it's good for making fun memories.

reviews.review_heading: Once an amitian always an amitian.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure at this college is good. It has many facilities, including Wi-Fi, a library, and an auditorium. The quality and quantity of the food are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Very pleasant campus with all the facilities available.
reviews.review_text: As being a biotechnology student, we are provided with very good lab facilities with all the necessities available! Lab hours are also scheduled in a very efficient manner! Wi-Fi is provided 24*7! Classrooms are big with a strength of 60 students! Medical facilities are also available! We have a canteen and food trucks in our campus!

reviews.review_heading: Good teaching faculty and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The maintenance of classrooms and labs is very good and the canteen is hygienic. Our college is also good at sports. Wi-Fi equipment is provided on campus. The library is very big with many authors available there. The hostel facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Great facilities, and the campus is so good.
reviews.review_text: The college has great infrastructure with a good campus building, and there are washrooms and a parking area. The college offers facilities like free Wi-Fi, good classrooms, and well-equipped labs. The library is useful to students, and the hostels and mess are good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, experience during studies was good.
reviews.review_text: Transportation, air-conditioned classrooms, a mess, and a canteen were the facilities, and infrastructure was newly built. The campus was small and far from the city. The quality of the food was not good. Students got food poisoning due to the bad and unhealthy food. Sports and games competitions used to take place, like badminton and basketball, majorly.

reviews.review_heading: Nice campus and has great facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities for students. The facilities provided are separate hostels for boys and girls with free Wi-Fi, good classrooms, labs and a well-stocked library. The mess is hygienic. The infrastructure is good with proper buildings and a pleasant environment.

reviews.review_heading: A brief information about Amity University, Raipur.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and a library are available and the campus is full of AC. Everything is good, but the quality of the food is the worst. We have a canteen, but most of the time it won't have food to buy, and outside food is not allowed on campus, even if it is homely food.

reviews.review_heading: Best private college in Chhattisgarh for our BBA course.
reviews.review_text: There are beautiful classrooms on our campus, with windows and A.C. All students are allowed to access free Wi-Fi. Overall, the infrastructure of the campus is very good. The hostel also has good infrastructure, providing facilities 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Amity university review by Seven Noel.
reviews.review_text: The syllabus is well structured and covers a good amount of all subjects and appropriate knowledge. As a hosteler, the food quality is average, the sports facilities are not that up-to-date, and the sports complex is not that developed but is improving .

review_summary.college_name: Sardar Patel Mahavidyalaya ,Chandrapur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My college story with my experience.

content.Placements: I am in my 1st year of BCA so I don't have that much knowledge about the highest and the lowest. I know 20% of students per year get placed in good companies. The average package is around 5-10 LPA. The college also provides internships for students to solve real-world problems.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is only for girls, not for boys so I can't explain. There should be a hostel for boys also. Our department was renovated last month. Now, it is very good for studying. The library is also big. There are two libraries. All books are very well-arranged and they are easy to find.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Computer Application - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Know about my college and see what I've shared.

content.Placements: I don't think any of the students in this course were placed through the college. They only approached internships and vacant placements and that's the way to get placements at this college that I know. The most offered roles were bankers and many IT professionals, etc.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is good according to the fees. Wi-Fi is available in the labs, it is clean and computers are available. Classrooms are good for studying. There is a library which is full of books, both related to the course and outside of the course is also available. Students can sit and study in the library, there are no restrictions.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The only opportunity to get a relevant degree at hand.

content.Placements: Around 300 students join this college every year. It is the only college in the whole district which provides the BCA course at an affordable fee for middle-class students. Salary packages are also quite good. Here you will get the opportunity to work with Accenture, TCs, and many more IT companies.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities available like labs, library, and classrooms are above average. Our college conducts inter-college sports as well as intra-college sports every year, which allows students to show their extra-curricular activities, be a part of everything and show their excellence.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Computer Application - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: No Placements and Average Teaching .

content.Placements: If I tell you honestly, in my 3 years of experience, there were no placements at the college. We always try to OFF CAMPUS PLACEMENTS. The college has the worst placements. I have done a B.Com. in computer application from here, and I'm telling you this college is the worst in placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is quite good. Wi-Fi, AIR CONDITIONER, GOOD QUALITY PCs available in our labs. But in the case of classrooms, its quite disappointing because the classroom is always very dusty, and we have to clean it every day on our own. And the library of the college is quite good; you can take any book along with you; every book is available there.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Our college has impressive faculty members.

content.Placements: For B.Sc., there are no placements through the college. However, most students take B.Sc. to prepare for the competitive exams or just to have a graduate degree for whichever exam they are pursuing. No one expects a job or placement on the basis of only a graduate degree.
content.Infrastructure: There's Wi-Fi for the practicals in BCA. The college even has an e-library, so students can browse whatever they want on the web if they don't find suitable information in books. Labs have all the facilities to perform every practical class. Classrooms are good for the fees paid.

faqs.question: Are there any government job opportunities that I can seek after completing B.A (Hons) in Fashion Design from Hamstech?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a BA degree in Fashion Design, students can seek out jobs in the government sector. The most suitable industry to pursue would be the Textile Industry. The Ministry of Textiles was set up by the Indian Government for planning, development, export promotion, and regulation of the textile industry. The ministry recruits candidates with relevant work experience and knowledge. A BA from Hamstech equips students with knowledge of various fields such as Draping, Design, Handloom, Textile and more. Students interested in pursuing a government job after the degree must stay updated with the official website of the Ministry of Textiles to know all the recent recruitment updates. As per unofficial sources, the monthly salary offered to students selected in the 2023 recruitment drive was INR 70,000. With more experience and enhanced skills, students can expect to get better pay in the future.

In terms of facilities, smart boards for better learning were available. Tech labs were also there. The library was accessible to students, and each lab had Wi-Fi facilities as well. Hostel facilities were quite good, and the quality of food in the mess was also good, along with the canteen food, which was really good. content.Placements: There are no proper placements for the technical courses, and it's a total time-pass. They can help you join any teaching companies, not the technical company, because of this, you will not have the experience of a technical background or the exposure.

individual_reviews.title: Best in the Ludhiana region.

content.Placements: Around 90% of the last year MBAs got their placements from the college itself. The average placement package was around 4 Lacs from companies like Vardhman, Times of India, Ralson, ITC, Bajaj Finserv, and many more. Students are offered a wide range of roles.

Classrooms are equipped with top-quality surveillance cameras and smart boards for a better learning experience. There are canteens at every corner of the college campus, offering tasty and hygienic options to both students and faculty.

individual_reviews.title: The college is average but good infrastructure and facilities, with average placements every year.

content.Placements: In the 2024 placement session, 70% of students from our course were placed. The highest package was around 10 LPA, and the lowest was about 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Trident, Vardhman, and ICICI Bank. Approximately 70% of B.Com students were placed in these companies and several others. The top positions offered included junior accountant, banking associate, and tax consultant.

individual_reviews.title: Best college in terms of return on investment.

content.Placements: I am a passout of the MBA (Marketing/HR) 2020 batch. The college provides 100% placements, which means each and every student was offered a job. Not good in medical facilities.
The gym is closing this year.
The canteens are very good; they have 8 canteens on the main campus and for 3rd year BBA and MBA students, there is another campus that has 2 canteens.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but less placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. We had basketball courts and volleyball courts, but they are like you have to pay for every sport you want to play. These people charge so much, yet they want more and more. Their education is not worth those rupees. That's it.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was very good. The campus area was hygienic, neat, and clean. All the classrooms were air-conditioned. Wi-Fi facilities were available throughout the campus. There were good facilities, like a medical room and canteen. They also conducted matches and tournaments in every sport.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for personality development.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are air-conditioned. There are 10 different canteens that serve budget-friendly food. Our campus is neat and clean with clean washrooms. Sanitary pad dispenser is available in every girls' washroom. Regular inter-class games and an annual sports meet for the whole college are held.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Ludhiana, Punjab.
reviews.review_text: All the modern facilities are available, like a library, projectors, labs etc. I will give 4 stars for the facilities and 3 stars for the hostel. Overall, the campus is very good, neat and clean. The food is bad, and hygiene is not maintained. Food in the international hostel is even worse.

reviews.review_heading: It is a college known for placements.
reviews.review_text: The college has comfortable facilities with an air-conditioning system in the classrooms. Moreso, boys' and girls' hostels are located in separate places and far away from each other to maintain security and discipline. The college also provides gym facilities to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life but placements will disappoint you and the fee is little expensive.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good and the classrooms are worth it. Labs are fine enough. Wi-Fi is generally not working fast. The library is not that useful. It has books only related to the curriculum that also for some technical courses only. Lawns are good and well maintained. There is also a big ground where sports activities are actually held. Hostels are spacious and clean. The food served is not good enough.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good quality education, teachers, good ambiance, and environment.
reviews.review_text: There were many international students in our college. Therefore, hostel facilities were very good. All the floors of college had Wi-Fi facility as well as classrooms were fully air conditioned. Food available in canteen and hostel mess was good and healthy.

reviews.review_heading: Punjab College of Technical Education is the best college for MBA .
reviews.review_text: Campus has Wi-Fi everywhere. There are computer labs and for Science, there are labs too. Classrooms are big, equipped with AC and are very neat and clean. Library is very big around 100 students can sit at a time there. Hostel facility of campus is very good. Mainly those students who are from other cities live there and also foreign students also. Quality of food is good and medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in terms of fees and infrastructure in the Ludhiana area.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities provided are good, and the quality of rooms is good as they are cleaned on daily basis. we have computer labs and chemical and physical labs. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. All the games are competed played on campus. Only rare students who are talented are accepted for university-level competitions. In terms of fees and infrastructure, it is very good.

The admission procedure at CT University includes the following steps: online/ offline application, meeting eligibility criteria, qualifying CTSET, preparation of a merit list, counseling for course selection, document verification, fee payment, and final admission. It's essential to check the university's website or contact the admission office for specific course requirements and updates. Find below the step-wise CT University admission process:
Step 1: CT University Application Process

The admission process begins with filling out an online application form on the official website of CT University or offline by visiting the campus. Apart from that, candidates need to appear for the CT SET entrance exams conducted by the university. The application for CT SET has to be filled out separately through the official website of the university.
Step 2: CT University Selection Rounds
Admission to CT University courses is both merit and entrance-based. For entrance-based admission, candidates are required to qualify for the CT SET exam.
Step 3: CT University Counselling Process/ Merit Release

Based on the scores in the CT SET, past academic records and performance of candidates in other selection rounds, the college releases a merit list. Further, for direct admissions, the college conducts a counselling process based on candidates' scores obtained in the last examination.
Step 4: Provisional Admission Notice

After the selection rounds, a provisional admission notice will be sent to the selected candidates. Later on, candidates can proceed with the other admission formalities such as fee payment and document verification (if required). For more details about the final admission process, candidates may visit the official website of CT University.

reviews.review_heading: Dr. D. Y. Patil ACS College - Empowering education in arts, commerce, and science.
reviews.review_text: It's quite good and the experience of the college is really next level. Though there is some shortage of sports and games, but the given facilities are top-notch. The quality of canteen food is also really tasty and craving. I like it and always whenever I go to eat there, I always have maggi with black coffee.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: I resided at my home, so I commuted to the college daily and did not know about the hostel facilities provided.

reviews.review_heading: It has really good infrastructure, excellent teachers, and coordinated staff members.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and toilets are very clean. Overall, it is an A+ grade in my opinion.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. D.Y. Patil Arts, Commerce and Science College.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in my college are good. Classrooms, a library, and all things are available in this course. The food quality offered in my college to students is good. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games are available in this course.

reviews.review_heading: Teaching staff, cleanliness, security, a library, and medical emergency services.
reviews.review_text: There were not many festival events. Some of them were Navratri Dandiya, Diwali, etc. You could take any book from the library you just needed a library card. You could even take reference books and semester books. There were fair events for sports, but not many. The students got along fine.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. D.Y. Patil Arts, Commerce and Science College.
reviews.review_text: There are all facilities. They are good. The department is also good. Wi-Fi service is there. There is a lab service. We have many hostel facilities. They are good. I have not taken a hostel pass. It is poor. My friends stay in the hostel. The quality is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. D.Y. Patil Arts, Commerce, and Science, Pimpri.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very poor. The college has Wi-Fi with a password but the connectivity is 0. There is no network on most of the floors. The campus is very small, with a law and women's colleges. The college doesn't have a canteen. I don't stay in the hostel, so I don't know much. Rooms are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are arrogant and egoistic but their knowledge is above par.
reviews.review_text: I have heard that the infrastructure is good. The food, water, and everything are fine, not good but not bad as well. Wi-Fi password is not given to students and it is only for faculty members. The library is amazing with all the academic books. Classrooms are big but the benches are small and broken. There are no sanitary pads in the girl's washrooms and no mirrors to check whether we're appropriately dressed. Washrooms stinks and there is no handwash, no issues, and no hand dryer. There is no ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. D.Y. Patil Arts, Commerce and Science College.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are present in this course. The infrastructure of this course is so good. Wi-Fi, classroom, and library—everything is present. The food quality made in this college is so good. Medical facilities are present. Sports and games are available in this course.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, likely average, but fine.
reviews.review_text: The campus area is small, but the college infrastructure is likely to be good, and the cleaning and peon staff are also good. The college has many departments such as sports, NCC, NSS, and computers. All the things in the college are average, but some outside students may not find them as good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr. DY Patil College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available for students in my college are so good. Wi-Fi and classrooms, as well as a library, are available in my college. The quality of food made in the canteen in college is so tasty, and medical facilities are available. However, sports are not available in my course.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Dr DY Patil Pimpri.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available. Good labs, well-maintained and better classrooms. The library is peaceful and has the required books, also very helpful while studying and during exams. The sports ground is available. Food in the canteen is better than outside, not going to lie. Medical facilities are available in emergencies too.

reviews.review_heading: Form my side college is okay.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is pretty good and peaceful. In front of the college gate, there is a Shree Swami Samarth small temple; it gives very positive vibes. There is good maintenance. Elevators for students and faculty. In our college, there are no hostels.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with educational values and teaching staff.
reviews.review_text: Our college with good infrastructure provides a comprehensive and supportive environment that encourages extracurricular activity. Classrooms were equipped with modern facilities such as projectors, comfortable seating arrangements, big library, and practical rooms.

reviews.review_heading: As I am in my third year right now, I am actually dissatisfied with the college management.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi provided for students. Computer labs are good, classrooms are average, and the library is average too. I don't know much about the hostel as I live with my family, but the computers in the computer lab are much lower than expected. There are a total of 6 labs, and each lab contains nearly 30 computers each.
